title: [Feature Request] ContextBridge - A lightweight cross-platform clipboard sync utility
author: SanjitGhose
summary: The request proposes a new Windows-and-Android clipboard synchronization product with a companion app and networking backend, not a bounded PowerToys bug fix.

status.label: Requires product direction
status.detail: A companion app, transport, privacy model, and service architecture need product approval before design.

next_action.label: No automated action
next_action.reason: Keep this feature request in normal product triage rather than presenting an implementation-ready fix.

judgment.rationale: The proposal is a substantial new cross-platform service whose product, privacy, and ownership decisions are outside a fast issue-to-fix judgment.
evidence: It requires Windows and Android applications.
The prototype uses Cloud Firestore while the issue also suggests peer-to-peer transport.
No product owner, assignee, milestone, or accepted scope is present.
Search found no existing PowerToys clipboard-sync tracker.
judgment.recommended_action: Leave maintainers to evaluate product fit, privacy, mobile ownership, and transport architecture.

issue_context.summary: ContextBridge would synchronize text and URLs between Windows and Android as a lightweight Phone Link alternative.
known_information: The reporter provides a public prototype and screenshots.
A PowerToys version might instead use local Wi-Fi peer-to-peer.
The issue only has Needs-Triage and no assignee.
inferences: Adoption would create ongoing mobile-client, protocol, identity, security, and privacy responsibilities.
issue_context.analysis: The prototype shows demand but does not settle product boundaries. The dashboard should not imply code design is ready before those decisions are owned.
initial_investigation: No duplicate or owned tracker was found.
No maintainer acceptance or requested evidence appears in discussion.
The alternative transports have materially different security and deployment models.

information_gaps.information: Maintainer decision on whether PowerToys should own a mobile companion and synchronization service.
information_gaps.why_needed: Determines whether repository implementation design is appropriate.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Product-owner triage, not an additional reporter checklist.
